text_en: But as for you, teach what is consistent with sound doctrine.
text_cn: 至于你，你所讲的，该合乎健全的道理；

text_en: Tell the older men to be temperate, serious, prudent, and sound in faith, in love, and in endurance.
text_cn: 教训老人应节制、端庄、慎重，在信德、爱德和忍耐上，要正确健全。

text_en: Likewise, tell the older women to be reverent in behavior, not to be slanderers or slaves to drink; they are to teach what is good,
text_cn: 也要教训老妇在举止上要圣善，不毁谤人，不沉湎于酒，但教人行善，

text_en: so that they may encourage the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,
text_cn: 好能教导青年妇女爱丈夫，爱子女，

text_en: to be self-controlled, chaste, good managers of the household, kind, being submissive to their husbands, so that the word of God may not be discredited.
text_cn: 慎重，贞节，勤理家务，良善，服从自己的丈夫，免得使人诋毁天主的圣道。

text_en: Likewise, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
text_cn: 你也要教训青年人在一切事上要慎重。

text_en: Show yourself in all respects a model of good works, and in your teaching show integrity, gravity,
text_cn: 你该显示自己为行善的模范，在教导上应表示纯正庄重，

text_en: and sound speech that cannot be censured; then any opponent will be put to shame, having nothing evil to say of us.
text_cn: 要讲健全无可指摘的话，使反对的人感到羞愧，说不出我们什么不好来。

text_en: Tell slaves to be submissive to their masters and to give satisfaction in every respect; they are not to talk back,
text_cn: 教训奴隶在一切事上要服从自己的主人，常叫他们喜悦，不要抗辩，

text_en: not to pilfer, but to show complete and perfect fidelity, so that in everything they may be an ornament to the doctrine of God our Savior.
text_cn: 不要窃取，惟要事事表示自己实在忠信，好使我们的救主天主的圣道，在一切事上获得光荣。

text_en: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all,
text_cn: 的确，天主救众人的恩宠已经出现，

text_en: training us to renounce impiety and worldly passions, and in the present age to live lives that are self-controlled, upright, and godly,
text_cn: 教导我们弃绝不虔敬的生活，和世俗的贪欲，有节地、公正地、虔敬地在今世生活，

text_en: while we wait for the blessed hope and the manifestation of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 期待所有希望的幸福，和我们伟大的天主及救主耶稣基督光荣的显现。

text_en: He it is who gave himself for us that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people of his own who are zealous for good deeds.
text_cn: 他为我们舍弃了自己，是为救赎我们脱离一切罪恶，洗净我们，使我们能成为他的选民，叫我们热心行善。

text_en: Declare these things; exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one look down on you.
text_cn: 你要宣讲这些事，以全权规劝和指摘，不要让任何人轻视你。
